shared_elements: linear incised carving on stone surface
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic linear carvings including small stick-like human figures, discs/rings and repeated short strokes, but that is about as far as it goes. A shows a scattered narrative field of manned boats with rows of crew-strokes, staff-bearing figures and free-floating star and crescent signs, whereas B is a single monolithic anthropomorphic body whose motifs (a ring on the chest, paired curved forms, a headdress-like band) are laid out to conform to the shape of the figure itself; the compositional logic and the specific motifs are unrelated.
